```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(moments)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(fst)

```


```{r}

incident_df <- read.fst("./datasets/basicincident_2019.fst", columns = c("INCIDENT_KEY", "STATE", "FDID", "INC_NO", "EXP_NO", "INC_TYPE", "AID", "ALARM", "ARRIVAL", "CENSUS"))

colnames(incident_df)

```


```{r}

nfirs_dept_df <- read.csv("./datasets/nfirs_dept.csv") %>%
  mutate(fire_and_hazmat = inci_type_cat_1 + inci_type_cat_2 + inci_type_cat_4,
         rescue_and_ems = inci_type_cat_3,
         public_service = inci_type_cat_5 + inci_type_cat_6 + inci_type_cat_7 + inci_type_cat_8,
         population_density = round(estimated_population / estimated_area_sq_mi),
         dept_type_condensed = as.factor(case_when(dept_type %in% c("Career", "Mostly career") ~ "Career",
                                   TRUE ~ "Volunteer")),
         response_time_category = as.factor(case_when(mean_response_time_mins <= 7.5 ~ "Fast",
                                                  TRUE ~ "Slow")))

```

```{r desc-stats}


response_times_by_dept_type_desc_stats_df <- nfirs_dept_df %>%
  group_by(dept_type_condensed) %>%
  summarise(
    n_depts = n(),
    mean_response_time = mean(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mean_response_time = sd(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_mean_response_time = min(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_mean_response_time = quantile(mean_response_time_mins, 0.25),
    median_mean_response_time = median(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_mean_response_time = quantile(mean_response_time_mins, 0.75),
    max_response_time = max(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  union(
    nfirs_dept_df %>%
      summarise(
        dept_type_condensed = "All Departments",
        n_depts = n(),
        mean_response_time = mean(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_mean_response_time = sd(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_mean_response_time = min(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE),
        q1_mean_response_time = quantile(mean_response_time_mins, 0.25),
        median_mean_response_time = median(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE),
        q3_mean_response_time = quantile(mean_response_time_mins, 0.75),
        max_response_time = max(mean_response_time_mins, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

response_times_by_dept_type_desc_stats_df %>%
  kbl()

```

## Response Time with No Aggregation Before Exclusion Criteria

### Descriptive Statistics

```{r before-exclusion-descriptive-stats, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, error=FALSE}

nfirs_dept_df %>%
  get_summary_stats(response_time_mins, type = "full",
                    show = c("n", "min", 
                             "q1", "median", "q3",  "max", "iqr", 
                             "mean", "sd")) %>%
  rename_with(.cols = everything(), .fn = title_columns) %>%
  rename(n = N,
         IQR = Iqr


         ) %>%
  kbl() %>%
  kable_material(c("striped", "hover"))

```

```{r t-test}
# equal variance
t.test(mean_response_time_mins ~ dept_type_condensed, data = nfirs_dept_df, var.equal = TRUE)

# unequal variance
t.test(mean_response_time_mins ~ dept_type_condensed, data = nfirs_dept_df, var.equal = FALSE)

nfirs_dept_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_response_time_mins)) +
  geom_histogram()

nfirs_dept_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_response_time_mins)) +
  geom_boxplot()

skewness(nfirs_dept_df$mean_response_time_mins)
kurtosis(nfirs_dept_df$mean_response_time_mins)

moments::agostino.test(nfirs_dept_df$mean_response_time_mins)
moments::anscombe.test(nfirs_dept_df$mean_response_time_mins)

var.test(mean_response_time_mins ~ dept_type_condensed, data = nfirs_dept_df)

```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)

nfirs_dept_df %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = population_density,
                  y = mean_response_time_mins),
              method = "lm") +
  geom_point(aes(x = population_density,
                 y = mean_response_time_mins,
                 color = dept_type_condensed)) +
  labs(
    title = "Population Density and Mean Response Time",
    subtitle = "2019",
    x = "Population Density (Population per square mile)",
    y = "Mean Response Time (Minutes)",
    color = "Department Type (Condensed)"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(x = population_density,
        y = mean_response_time_mins,
        color = dept_type_condensed),
    method = "lm"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 21) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4472c4", "#C49644")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 20)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))
  # Double the base font size



```

```{r chi-square}

chisq <- chisq.test(nfirs_dept_df$dept_type, nfirs_dept_df$response_time_category)

chisq

chisq$residuals %>% kbl()
chisq$expected %>% kbl()
chisq$observed %>% kbl()

resid_df <-
  rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(chisq$expected), "nfirs_dept_df.dept_type") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Fast, Slow),
               names_to = "response_time_category",
               values_to = "expected") %>%
  inner_join(
    as.data.frame(chisq$observed) %>%
      rename(response_time_category = Var2,
             observed = Freq)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    as.data.frame(chisq$residuals) %>%
      rename(response_time_category = Var2,
             residual = Freq)
  ) %>%
  rename(dept_type_expanded = nfirs_dept_df.dept_type) %>%
  mutate(diff = observed - expected)

resid_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dept_type_expanded, y = residual, fill = response_time_category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")

resid_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dept_type_expanded, y = expected, fill = response_time_category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge")


resid_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dept_type_expanded, y = diff, fill = response_time_category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge")

resid_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = response_time_category, y = diff, fill = dept_type_expanded)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    labs(
    title = "Departments and Response Time Category",
    subtitle = "2019",
    x = "Response Time Category",
    y = "Observed - Expected",
    color = "Department Type (Expanded)"
  ) +   scale_fill_manual(values = c("#C49644", "#e1caa1", "#a1b8e1", "#4472c4")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 20)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))
  # Double the base font size


```
